#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;
const int MAXN = 510;
int n,m,mod;
ll C[MAXN][MAXN], F[MAXN], G[MAXN];
ll DP[MAXN][MAXN], WAYS[MAXN][MAXN];
ll DP2[MAXN][MAXN], WAYS2[MAXN][MAXN];
ll DP0[MAXN][MAXN], WAYS0[MAXN][MAXN];

inline void add_mod(ll &x, ll y) {
    x = (x + y) % mod;
}
inline ll comb2(ll x) {
    return (x * (x - 1) / 2) % mod;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    cin >> n >> m >> mod;
    for(int i = 0; i < MAXN; ++i) C[i][0] = 1;
    for(int i = 1; i < MAXN; ++i) {
        for(int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
            C[i][j] = (C[i-1][j-1] + C[i-1][j]) % mod;
        }
    }

    F[0] = 0; G[0] = 1;
    for(int i = 1; i <= m; ++i) {
        for(int j = 1; j <= i; ++j) {
            ll term1 = C[i-1][j-1] * F[j-1] % mod * G[i-j] % mod * (i+1) % mod;
            ll term2 = C[i-1][j-1] * G[j-1] % mod * F[i-j] % mod * (i+1) % mod;
            ll term3 = (C[i-1][j-1] * G[j-1] % mod * G[i-j] % mod) * ((comb2(j) + comb2(i-j+1)) % mod) % mod;
            add_mod(F[i], (term1 + term2 + term3) % mod);
            add_mod(G[i], C[i-1][j-1] * G[j-1] % mod * G[i-j] % mod * (i+1) % mod);
        }
    }

    DP[0][0] = 0; WAYS[0][0] = 1;
    for(int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        memset(DP2, 0, sizeof(DP2));
        memset(WAYS2, 0, sizeof(WAYS2));
        for(int j = 0; j <= min(i, m); ++j) {
            for(int k = 0; k <= min(j, m); ++k) {
                if(k == 0) {
                    DP0[i][j] = DP[j][0];
                    WAYS0[i][j] = WAYS[j][0];
                }

                add_mod(DP2[j][0], DP[j][k]);
                add_mod(WAYS2[j][0], WAYS[j][k]);

                int rem = m - (j - k);
                add_mod(WAYS2[j+1][k+1], WAYS0[i-k][j-k] * C[rem][k+1] % mod * G[k+1] % mod);
                add_mod(DP2[j+1][k+1], (DP0[i-k][j-k] * C[rem][k+1] % mod * G[k+1] + WAYS0[i-k][j-k] * C[rem][k+1] % mod * F[k+1]) % mod);
            }
        }
        for(int j = 0; j < MAXN; ++j)
            for(int k = 0; k < MAXN; ++k) {
                DP[j][k] = DP2[j][k];
                WAYS[j][k] = WAYS2[j][k];
            }
    }

    ll ans = 0;
    for(int i = 0; i <= m; ++i)
        add_mod(ans, DP[m][i]);
    cout << ans << '\n';
    return 0;
}
